      "observations": [
        "All 31 owned paths and every hunk were read: controller/header/container/views, production templates, 14 standalone fixture templates, Fluent strings, the new 208-line browser test and manifest, theme packaging/CSS, and all three SVG bodies. All are Thunderbird-owned. Exact current comparisons use the fixed accepted revision; unchanged SVG blobs are reused by exact identity, not claimed as new visual inspection.",
        "The state owner is the controller. Minimizing calls dialog.close without resetting currentView, shows the placeholder, toggles the minimized class and flips the state flag. Restoring sets globalOverlay and shows the modal, then hides the placeholder. The native close listener clears globalOverlay. A checked tabmail command enabled-state consumer returns false when the overlay flag is true; broader every-command blocking is not inferred from that one path.",
        "open(type) has a minimized early return: it restores the existing view before reset or requested-flow loading. Both email and address-book initUI dispatch request-maximize after template loading and before exposing a subview. request-close ignores a minimized hub. The owned native-cancel no-account guard and accepted later first-run key handling are different phases, not attributed to this one patch.",
        "The moved #reset guard is synchronous: it assigns currentView.reset() to isClean, tests truthiness, hides views and clears currentView, then returns that same value. Both actual email and address-book receivers are async, already in the owned revision and still at the fixed accepted revision. Their immediate return is a Promise, not completion or the eventual Boolean result. Therefore this guard does not await cleanup completion or observe a later rejection. This is a local static contract mismatch; it is not claimed as a new regression or a reproduced close failure.",
        "The address-book sync path awaits each create and then calls openAddressBook. That helper dispatches request-close, separately clears globalOverlay and calls toAddressBook. If the hub remains minimized at that request, the controller skips its reset/close branch; this helper itself does not request maximization. Review proposed a future confirmation flow, but neither that proposal nor acceptance proves an implemented completion repair. No stuck-state, navigation outcome or race was reproduced.",
        "The header sends composed, bubbling close/toggle events from its shadow tree. The placeholder is one complete localized button outside the dialog; its listener dispatches toggle from the modal. Both components guard initial setup with an existing shadowRoot. Header listener-removal code is removed, while container localization still disconnects/deletes separately. The existing guard means a later reconnection does not rerun initialization; no generic reconnect support or leak result is claimed.",
        "All changed fixtures receive concrete minimize/close markup because the real header clones a template from its owning document. The existing scoped fixture lesson is linked rather than repeated as a new harness rule. Current production and selected fixture markup have later layout/branding changes; their existence is not proof that this original fixture body stayed identical.",
        "The new test checks dialog.open and placeholder.hidden through minimize, Escape and whole-placeholder click; simulates a hidden subview transition by calling footerForward.click; and requests ADDRESS_BOOK while minimized but expects the email config view to survive. The real wait/close/fill helpers were read. Every new assertion has a non-empty should message. One message is inaccurate: the programmatic reopen assertion says after clicking the placeholder, although its action is openAccountHub(ADDRESS_BOOK). That scoped diagnostic mismatch remains in accepted code; the action and expected retained view are recorded separately.",
        "The icon variables use -sm, both new SVGs declare 16 by 16, widget classes use currentColor context stroke and explicit RTL mirroring, and the manifest packages their exact resource URLs. The existing close SVG keeps its 16 by 16 viewBox but changes its path. Fluent supplies Minimize and Maximize Account Hub titles with empty decorative image alt text. No pixel, accessible-name computation, hit-target size, contrast or screen-reader outcome was measured.",
        "Manual CSS checks preserve the actual flattened minimized selector, logical placeholder/header placement, explicit header gap, footer color-surface-border divider and .busy & ancestor selector. Footer separators change from a text middot to a small pseudo-element dot. The owned placeholder light-dark border differs from accepted selected-item-color styling. Review suggestions, rejected alternatives and later token changes are not merged into a single timeless style rule.",
        "Complete Bug 1987253 and D270800 are retained with no required gaps. The full review includes 43 actual current/outdated inline bodies and its creation-to-final timeline; there are no summary edits. The Bug corrects the initial OAuth framing and explains the need to read another account's verification mail. Earlier dialog/new-tab alternatives remain historical.",
        "Close/cancel reasoning, moving common toggle state outside branches, retaining owned shadow-button listeners, localization-before-append and deletion, and maximizing on both email/address-book subview changes were checked against actual landed source. The unused body-class alternative was not adopted. A suggestion to reset/close while minimized was rejected; the async address-book completion concern and future confirmation response remain explicit limits.",
        "Design review requested RTL direction, size-named icons, consistent divider color, a whole clickable placeholder and a maximize title with Account Hub context. Exact code adopts RTL mirroring, -sm variables, color-surface-border, a whole button listener and the contextual title. The initial accent-versus-dark-border rationale belongs to the owned phase; accepted later selected-item-color is separate. Historical screenshots and VoiceOver comments were not reproduced.",
        "The review caught an incorrect .busy & rewrite, and actual source retains the ancestor-busy selector. It also requested flattening the minimized selector. Both code outcomes were verified. The test-review missing-assert discussion concerned leftover comments; actual landed assertions, synthetic transition and retained-flow expectation were read directly. The inaccurate programmatic-reopen message is an independent scoped source finding, not resolved by approval.",
        "Historical OAuth interruption, build/lint/Try comments and approvals remain private reports. They do not prove current cancellation, cleanup completion, async address-book behavior, visual quality or accessibility success."
